answers.workaround:
Locally - yes, but I don't quite see a way how two variables can be swapped using a utility function:

```gdscript
static func swap(a, b):
	var tmp = a
	a = b
	b = tmp

func _ready():
	var a = 1
	var b = 2
	swap(a, b)
	print(a) # Prints 1, not swapped.
	print(b) # Prints 2, not swapped.
```

This is because primitive types cannot be passed by reference in GDScript, as seen in this Q&A question:
- [How do I pass variables by reference to functions?](https://godotengine.org/qa/32684/how-do-i-pass-variables-by-reference-to-functions)

For those who port existing code to GDScript, this could result in difficult-to-debug errors.

title: Add a method to swap two variables in GDScript
